response:
Diagnosis of prior round: four of six proposals were rejected because every "quality" channel I used (ib, oancf, at, sale) is shared with the profitability menu — the validator needs at least one quality-exclusive variable (dltt, dlc, lt, act, lct, re). The one accepted positive-sign signal (HealthScoredProfitability) worked directionally but with modest alpha and low coverage (0.12), and the negative-sign "fragile profitability" idea failed outright (FMB slope came in positive), so the debt-growth-as-fragility channel is dropped. This batch (a) always includes a quality-exclusive balance-sheet variable, (b) tests additive vs multiplicative conditioning against the archive winner, and (c) opens three genuinely new channels: earnings-stability-scaled return on invested capital, debt-service-adjusted profit spread, and capital-structure stability as the quality modulator.

---SIGNAL 1---
NAME: StableROIC
EXPRESSION: WINSOR(RATIO(MA(RATIO(oiadp, ADD(dltt, ceq)), 3), VOL(RATIO(oiadp, ADD(dltt, ceq)), 5)), 1)
HYPOTHESIS: Return on total invested capital (debt plus equity) is a cleaner measure of operating strength than ROA, and its predictive power for returns is concentrated in firms whose invested-capital return is stable rather than cyclical.
EXPECTED_SIGN: positive
REASONING: The numerator is smoothed operating profit over invested capital (profitability theme, using oiadp and dltt), and the denominator is the five-year volatility of that same return (quality theme, stability of the capital-productivity stream). Two firms with identical ROIC are ranked purely by durability, so the signal is an information-ratio-style interaction rather than a level effect. Scaling by dltt+ceq rather than at also removes the mechanical leverage tilt embedded in equity-based profitability.
INTERACTION_TYPE: ratio

---SIGNAL 2---
NAME: AdditiveHealthProfit
EXPRESSION: SUMRANK(MA(RATIO(oibdp, at), 3), SUMRANK(RATIO(re, at), RATIO(SUB(act, lct), lt)))
HYPOTHESIS: Profitability and balance-sheet health both carry independent premia, and an additive rank combination should span more of the cross-section (avoiding the rank-product compression that pushes moderate firms to the middle) while retaining the same economic story.
EXPECTED_SIGN: positive
REASONING: This deliberately isolates one design choice relative to the archive winner: the same three channels (smoothed EBITDA/assets, retained-earnings depth, net working capital over total liabilities) combined additively rather than multiplicatively. If the multiplicative form's alpha was limited by extreme-rank concentration and unstable long/short membership, the additive version should raise ls_talpha and Sharpe; if instead the conditioning is essential, the additive version will weaken, which is itself informative.
INTERACTION_TYPE: composite

---SIGNAL 3---
NAME: DebtServicedProfitSpread
EXPRESSION: SUMRANK(RATIO(SUB(oiadp, xint), at), WINSOR(RATIO(oibdp, ADD(dltt, dlc)), 2))
HYPOTHESIS: Profitability that survives the cost of debt service and that comfortably covers the outstanding debt stock is durable operating strength, whereas equally high pre-interest profitability on a heavily indebted balance sheet is transient and largely a claim of creditors.
EXPECTED_SIGN: positive
REASONING: The first channel is operating profit net of interest expense scaled by assets (profitability theme), the second is EBITDA coverage of total debt (quality theme via dltt and dlc), so leverage enters through earnings capacity rather than as a raw balance-sheet ratio. Firms with negative EBITDA automatically receive a low coverage rank, so the interaction does not invert for distressed names. This tests debt-service capacity as the quality modulator, a channel absent from the archive.
INTERACTION_TYPE: composite

---SIGNAL 4---
NAME: SelfFundedProfitStreak
EXPRESSION: MUL(IND_RANK(MA(RATIO(oibdp, at), 3)), TS_SUM(INDICATOR(DELTA(re, 1), 0), 5))
HYPOTHESIS: High profitability is durable when it has been repeatedly retained inside the firm; a multi-year record of rising retained earnings shows profits are real, self-funding, and not paid out or reversed by later write-offs.
EXPECTED_SIGN: positive
REASONING: The industry rank of smoothed EBITDA/assets (profitability) is multiplied by a count of the last five years in which retained earnings actually increased (quality-exclusive persistence via re), so profitability is credited only when it has accumulated. This is a discrete persistence-of-accretion mechanism, distinct from level-based health scores and from earnings-volatility scaling. Firms with high current margins but an eroding retained-earnings base are pulled toward the middle of the distribution.
INTERACTION_TYPE: conditional

---SIGNAL 5---
NAME: WorkingCapitalCleanProfit
EXPRESSION: SUMRANK(RATIO(SUB(SUB(revt, cogs), xsga), at), NEG(DELTA(RATIO(SUB(act, lct), sale), 1)))
HYPOTHESIS: Operating profitability is higher quality when it is not accompanied by an expanding working-capital footprint; receivable and inventory build-up relative to sales signals earnings that have not yet been realized in cash and tend to reverse.
EXPECTED_SIGN: positive
REASONING: The first channel is a clean operating profitability level built from revt, cogs and xsga (profitability theme), while the second penalizes year-over-year growth in net working capital intensity using act and lct (quality-exclusive). Unlike a total-accruals measure, this isolates the specific balance-sheet account where transient profitability shows up first, giving a different economic channel with broad coverage.
INTERACTION_TYPE: composite

---SIGNAL 6---
NAME: QuietBalanceSheetProfit
EXPRESSION: WINSOR(RATIO(MA(RATIO(oiadp, at), 3), VOL(RATIO(lt, at), 5)), 1)
HYPOTHESIS: Firms that earn high operating returns while holding their capital structure steady are running a genuinely profitable business; firms whose liability base swings year to year are financing, restructuring, or acquiring their way to reported profitability.
EXPECTED_SIGN: positive
REASONING: The numerator is smoothed operating profitability (profitability theme) and the denominator is the volatility of the total-liabilities-to-assets ratio (quality theme via lt), so the signal rewards profits earned on a stable financing base. This makes capital-structure stability, not earnings smoothness, the durability filter, giving a mechanism that is orthogonal to Signal 1 and to accrual-based quality. Because it needs only lt and oiadp histories, coverage should be materially higher than the multi-variable health scores.
INTERACTION_TYPE: ratio
